en: The postcard features a black-and-white image of a ruined castle atop a hill, surrounded by forested mountains. In the valley below, there is a chapel and some buildings. The text is in Croatian, with printed red text and handwritten notes. The upper right corner says 'Pozdrav iz Samobora' (Greetings from Samobor), and the lower part reads 'Stari grad sa kapelom sv. Mihajla u Samoboru' (Old town with the chapel of St. Michael in Samobor).
